style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight

motion_rule: the camera whips round the hero and never stops, a hard arc every beat, dropping to the sand and rising over the crates, new shot size every beat, medium to close, the hero filling half the frame. audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable, nothing in it
